about: Each listed state's regions in coast order, by URL slug, for its state page (docs/DECISIONS.md 0039). A listed state must list every one of its regions exactly once. A state not listed here has its regions north to south by the average latitude of their stations. California's order was reviewed and approved by the owner on 2026-11-14: down the north coast, into San Francisco Bay and the Delta rivers, then back out to the coast and south.
